title: Supraglottic Airway Devices in Pediatric Difficult Airway Situations
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to compare three supraglottic airway devices (Combitube, Easytube, laryngeal mask airway) to endotracheal intubation in a simulated difficult airway scenario in a pediatric manikin.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* pediatricians
* residents
* interns
* written informed consent form

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
